description: Medical alert, home care and senior services

entries.name: Alert Medical Alarms
entries.service_area_detail: Pennsylvania-based Medicaid PERS provider
entries.notes: Mostly billed to Medicaid waiver programs and care managers. Customer-service page  lists regional managers and 1-800-716-8035 extensions; it is aimed at Medicaid-waiver care managers. No consumer billing, autopay or cancel doc.

entries.name: ADT Health / ADT Medical Alert
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide; medical alert billed on the ADT account
entries.notes: Service Billing FAQs: month-to-month agreement, no long-term contract; the Price-Lock Guarantee is no longer offered; Premium Protection Plan included; call the ADT Health number on the Contact page with billing questions. EasyPay article: EasyPay is ADT's free autopay, enrolled in MyADT (myadt.com) > Billing tab > EasyPay tile (bank account or card); starts next billing cycle; change or manage it later via Manage EasyPay on the Billing screen; Express Pay handles one-time payments.

entries.name: Alert1
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS
entries.phone_customer_service: 1-877-579-9862 option 2 (Member Care, M-F 9am-5:30pm ET); option 3 technical help
entries.mail_payment_address: Alert1, 1000 Commerce Park Drive, Suite 300, Williamsport, PA 17701 (FAQ: "What address do I mail my payment to?")
entries.notes: FAQ (alert-1.com/faq) has a Pricing section: which cards are accepted, bank-account payment, annual-renewal reminder, and the mail-to address for payments. It says checking-account (ACH) payment must be set up by calling, because the website does not support it. Account and card updates are made on the My Account page (alert-1.com/my-account) or through Member Care at 1-877-579-9862 option 2. The Member Care Hub page (alert-1.com/current-members) gives the same numbers; an older 800-693-5433 number still appears in search snippets. FAQ/terms text no longer renders server-side. The pricing page's FAQ (read from the site's JS bundle) says plans can be paid monthly or in advance (prepaid), there is no long-term contract, and any user may cancel at any time by returning the equipment. Billing/cancel by phone: Member Care 1-877-579-9862 option 2. Mail payments to 1000 Commerce Park Drive, Suite 300, Williamsport, PA 17701 or pay online. Visa, Mastercard, Discover and AmEx are accepted. Checking-account debit must be set up by phone. A courtesy billing reminder is emailed 30 days before the annual renewal date. Member Care 1-877-579-9862 ext 2 (M-F 9am-5:30pm ET).

entries.name: Aloe Care Health
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide smart-hub PERS with caregiver app
entries.notes: The Zendesk help center has no bill-pay or autopay article; subscriptions are charged automatically to the card on file. To cancel, call 888-256-3227 with the care recipient's name, address and account email. Terms of Service  is the only billing doc: the subscriber authorizes Aloe Care to charge the card or checking account on file for the Monitoring Service Fee (monthly, or prepaid up to 12 months); a written billing statement is provided on request; month-to-month service ends 30 days after written notice; annual plans refund fully in month 1, prorated through month 5, none after month 6; equipment must be shipped back or paid for at published replacement rates. Cancel by calling 888-256-3227. The help center has no billing/payment articles. Month-to-month, terminate with 30 days written notice; annual-subscription refund terms. Online account login (store.aloecare.com/account, redirects to /login) is where orders and the subscription are managed; support 1-888-256-3227, support@getaloecare.com. Cancel article: cancellation must be by phone with support at 888-256-3227 after identity checks (care recipient name, address, account email).

entries.name: Bay Alarm Medical
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS; Concord, CA
entries.senior_programs: Health partnerships page for payers/providers; no senior discount documented.
entries.notes: Customer-service page: payments, payment-method updates and account details are done in the free Account Manager mobile app / online dashboard. FAQ ('Fees & Payments'): payment is taken automatically on the same date each month (autopay is the default billing method). Cancellation page: cancels due to death can be done in the app/dashboard; otherwise call; return in-home devices to 1140 Galaxy Way Suite #150, Concord, CA 94520; billing stops when device is received. Cards only (Visa, MasterCard, Discover; no AmEx), billed monthly, quarterly or annually on the same date, and billing info is updated in the Account Manager dashboard. App page  says the Bay Alarm Medical app is used to make payments, update credit cards and view account status. FAQ 'Fees & Payments': payment is taken automatically on the same date every month; questions to the Billing Department 1-877-522-9633. Cancel = the /cancellations/ page: call (online cancel only for a death, via app/dashboard), ship in-home equipment to Bay Alarm Medical, 1140 Galaxy Way Suite #150, Concord, CA 94520; billing stops when the device is received and inspected, with any charges during the wait refunded. 15-day full refund; prorated refund afterward.

entries.name: Connect America (enterprise / payer PERS)
entries.service_area_detail: PERS for Medicaid waiver, Medicare Advantage, health systems; absorbed Tunstall Americas (tunstallamericas.com redirects here)
entries.senior_programs: PERS supplied through Medicare Advantage, Medicaid and commercial health plans (payers page); many members pay nothing directly. Consumer self-pay customers are served under the MedicalAlert.com brand (billpay.medicalalert.com).
entries.notes: Consumers covered by Medicaid/MA usually pay nothing directly; private-pay consumers are billed through the Lifeline or MedicalAlert.com brands. Former Tunstall Americas customers now fall under Connect America. Terms page covers website use only. Private-pay billing and cancellation for Connect America brands are documented under Lifeline (billpay.lifeline.com, 1-800-635-6156) and MedicalAlert.com (support/terms page, 1-800-906-0872, support@connectamerica.com). Consumer brands MedicalAlert.com (billpay.medicalalert.com) and Lifeline (billpay.lifeline.com) carry the bill-pay portals.

entries.name: Electronic Caregiver
entries.parent_company: SameDay Security, Inc. (brands Electronic Caregiver, Addison Care, PocketMD; Las Cruces, NM)
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS/remote monitoring
entries.notes: Service Agreement: 1-year initial term that auto-renews for further 1-year terms unless either side gives 30 days written notice before the term ends (month-to-month if the renewal clause is unenforceable, with 30 days notice before a calendar month); you may cancel until midnight of the 3rd business day after signing; if you end service during the initial term the company sends an RMA tag and box and the system must be returned promptly; on breach the company keeps prepayments and may charge 80% of the remaining term. Fees are set on the Order Form; no online bill-pay page is published, so payment and cancellation go through (833) 324-5433.

entries.name: Galaxy Medical Alert Systems
entries.service_area_detail: Canadian (Windsor, ON) DTC PERS that also sells in the U.S.; prices are in Canadian funds
entries.payment_processor: WooCommerce store (My Account); Stripe scripts on site; recurring charges to card or bank account on file
entries.notes: Annual plans are prepaid. Galaxy Medical Alert Systems Ltd. is based in Windsor, Ontario (361 Joffre Place) and its site states 'All prices are in Canadian funds', so U.S. customers should expect CAD-denominated charges. Terms: three-month agreement that auto-renews unless either side gives 30 days' written notice; payment monthly, quarterly or yearly; recurring charges go to the card or bank account provided; prepaid fees refunded for 90 days after termination only if equipment is returned. Shipping & Returns policy: to cancel or return, first call customer care 1-866-945-5027 (M-F 9-5 ET) for a return authorization number. FAQ: you can pay by your own card for service to a parent. Shipping & Returns page  confirms customer care 1-866-945-5027 for return authorization. Terms page states 'All prices are in Canadian funds'. Low U.S. relevance; kept for completeness. Recurring card charges or automatic bank draft for private-pay customers; agency/government customers billed through the agency.

entries.name: GetSafe
entries.parent_company: Bay Alarm Medical / Bay Alarm Company
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide wall-button PERS brand
entries.notes: Sister brand of Bay Alarm Medical (same Concord, CA operation). Customer-support page is JS-rendered. Assume billing handled like Bay Alarm (automatic monthly charge). Customer support phone 1-888-799-6255. GetSafe customer-support page  still shows only setup videos and phone 1-888-799-6255. No billing, autopay or cancel doc is published; call 1-888-799-6255. Pricing page: equipment is bought up front, then monitoring is $29.95/month (fall detection +$10/month); it says the main base console must be returned on cancellation (other purchased equipment is kept). The Terms of Use have no billing terms; cancel and billing questions go to 1-888-799-6255 (M-F 7am-3:30pm PT).

entries.name: Guardian Medical Monitoring
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS, sold directly and through dealers; Florida-licensed monitoring
entries.notes: Not the same company as Medical Guardian or Guardian Protection (alarm). View/pay invoices, payment history, AutoPAY, eDelivery and one-time guest pay. Login/register, one-time payment.

entries.name: HandsFree Health (WellBe)
entries.service_area_detail: Voice-assistant speaker, pendant and watch PERS sold online and at retail
entries.notes: Search snippets say subscriptions renew monthly to the card on file and must be canceled in the shop.handsfreehealth.com account at least 72 hours before the next charge; a canceled device cannot be reactivated. The company may no longer be operating, so confirm before relying on this. DNS still resolves (WP Engine), but the TLS handshake fails, so the site cannot be loaded. No billing page can be reached; treat the brand as likely discontinued. Existing subscribers should check their card statement for recurring charges and dispute them with the card issuer if service has stopped. Treat as discontinued for new customers.

entries.name: Life Alert
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS (home, mobile GPS, shower button)
entries.notes: Life Alert publishes no online account portal, bill-pay page, or billing FAQ; the site is sales-oriented and the contact page says to call about managing accounts. Service is typically a multi-year contract billed monthly/annually; billing, payment and cancellation are by phone only. Record the number printed on the customer's invoice. Third-party sites (pissedconsumer.com, 19pine.ai) list a billing department line of 1-800-803-6320 and Member Services at 1-800-360-0329. Use the number on the invoice. Cost page  describes monthly service rates, 'flexible payment options', discounted pricing when you pay one year in advance, free equipment/installation and a price-lock; quotes and payment are by phone 1-800-990-0595. The Monitoring Service Agreement is reported to run 3 years and end early only on death, a move to 24/7 care or 24/7 skilled in-home nursing, then month-to-month; check your signed agreement or call 1-800-990-0595.

entries.name: LifeFone
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS
entries.senior_programs: Lifetime price guarantee (price never rises for the service you keep); free spouse monitoring on At-Home Landline/Cellular basic service; refer-a-friend free months (FAQ).
entries.notes: Online Bill Pay is at https://payments.lifefone.com/payment/ and the LifeFone Account Portal is at /customer-portal. FAQ: no time commitment (a service agreement is signed); cancel any time by phone (1-800-940-0262), email or mail; billing stops when the equipment is received; only full prepaid months are refunded. An earlier search-snippet billing number, 1-877-330-3664, was not seen on the site and is dropped. Plans are billed monthly, quarterly or annually. Address: 16 Yellowstone Avenue, White Plains, NY 10607-1324. Customer portal page lists 'Billing & Payments - pay your account online using our secure automated service' (links to https://payments.lifefone.com/payment/) plus profile, caregiver and location portals. FAQ: cancel by calling Customer Care 1-800-940-0262 (or notify by phone, email or mail); return equipment at your own expense; LifeFone stops billing once the equipment is received and refunds full unused prepaid months (no partial-month refunds); 30-day risk-free trial. Emergency-profile updates: 1-877-330-3658 or profileupdates@lifefone.com; LifeFone Profile Updates, 16 Yellowstone Avenue, White Plains, NY 10607-1324 (profile mail, not a payment address).

entries.name: Lifeline (formerly Philips Lifeline)
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide; the largest legacy US PERS brand, acquired from Philips by Connect America in 2021
entries.payment_processor: billpay.lifeline.com portal (account number required, no login)
entries.senior_programs: AARP member discount; contact page asks whether insurance plan or Medicaid pays for the service.
entries.notes: Support page has a 'Billing Support' FAQ: what the invoice covers, why a paper-invoice fee applies, and Auto Pay (enroll by mailing the direct-debit form or calling 1-800-635-6156; paper invoices stop after enrollment). Auto Pay continues after cancellation until the equipment is returned. Transaction history is NOT viewable on the website; confirm payment on your bank/card statement. One-time online payment at billpay.lifeline.com. Cancel by phone 1-800-635-6156. The billing FAQ still matches. A separate line for medication-dispenser billing is 888-632-3261. Support page Billing Support FAQ  also covers paperless: enrolling in Auto Pay (mail the direct-debit form or call 800-635-6156) stops paper invoices and the paper-invoice fee, so paperless = same page. Copies of invoices or account-history printouts are requested via the Contact Us form ('Billing'). Billing date cannot be changed. Auto Pay stops once cancelled service equipment is received. Subscriber terms: https://www.lifeline.com/support/subscriber-terms-and-conditions/. Auto Pay signup by mailed direct-debit form or 800-635-6156; paper-invoice fee avoided by Auto Pay; no monthly statement once on Auto Pay (confirm on bank/card statement).

entries.name: LifeProtect 24/7
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS
entries.notes: Help page: reach the non-emergency customer care and billing department through the form or 1-844-203-5617. Help page  is a contact form for the 'non-emergency customer care and billing department' plus phone 1-844-203-5617. No public pay-bill, autopay, statement or cancel/return doc; handle all billing by phone. The FAQ has no pricing, contract, cancellation or return terms; billing questions go to the non-emergency customer care and billing department at 1-844-203-5617 or the help-page contact form.

entries.name: LifeStation
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS; also Medicaid partner programs
entries.payment_processor: LifeStation invoice-payment page (customer number + last name lookup)
entries.senior_programs: Medicaid partner programs (https://www.lifestation.com/medicaid-partner-programs/); veterans page; FSA/HSA eligibility pages.
entries.notes: Online invoice payment by customer number and last name at /pay/. FAQ: billing monthly, quarterly or annually; cancel any time by calling customer service, no cancellation fees. Cancellation is not processed until leased equipment is returned; there is a full refund within the 30-day introductory period. Terms and conditions: month-to-month agreement that auto-renews; end it any time by returning the system; paying by EFT or credit card authorizes LifeStation to debit that account until you cancel the authorization in writing. FAQ: billing can be monthly, quarterly or annual; cards accepted are AmEx, Visa, Mastercard and Discover, plus Visa/Mastercard debit; no cancellation fees; call customer service for return instructions. The /pay/ page lets you look up and pay an outstanding invoice by customer number and last name. No statement-history or paperless doc published. Invoice search by customer number and last name, then online payment. Customer Invoice Payment page: look up an outstanding invoice by customer number and last name, then pay online.

entries.name: Lively (formerly GreatCall / Jitterbug) medical alert and phone plans
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide; Lively Mobile2/Mobile Plus medical alert devices and Jitterbug phones (greatcall.com and jitterbug.com redirect here)
entries.senior_programs: HSA/FSA reimbursement guidance on Payments page (cards not accepted directly).
entries.notes: Billing page explains the monthly statement (with a sample PDF) and payment options. Payments page has direct-debit and credit-card autopay PDF forms; recurring payments can also be set in My Account. Cancel/change plan by phone or via a cancellation form linked from the My Account dashboard. Also appears under wireless carriers. Members of health-plan-paid CST programs usually owe nothing; any bill would come from Lively/Best Buy Health or the plan. The Direct Payment (automatic checking/savings debit) form on the Payments help page has a checkbox to enroll in paperless billing; you then get a monthly email to view the statement free at lively.com/MyAccount. Payments help page: automated pay line 1-866-237-8641 (free, 24/7); paying through an advisor at 1-800-733-6632 carries a $5 processing fee; mail to Lively, P.O. Box 660688, Dallas, TX 75266-0688; credit-card payment form PDF https://d1627bu5af42hi.cloudfront.net/assets/credit-card-payment.form.pdf. Example statement PDF, direct-payment and credit-card autopay forms, recurring card payments in My Account.

entries.name: LogicMark (Freedom Alert, Guardian Alert 911)
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide; major supplier of PERS to the VA; many devices have no monthly fee
entries.senior_programs: Veterans can get devices through the VA (Veterans Affairs pages).
entries.notes: Guardian Alert 911/911 Plus and original Freedom Alert have no monthly fee. Freedom Alert Max ($34.99/mo monitoring + $20 cellular) and Freedom Alert Plus ($24.99/mo) have monitoring subscriptions set up by calling 1-800-519-2419 with a credit card; there is no public self-service billing portal. Freedom Alert and Guardian Alert 911 are unmonitored with NO monthly fee. Monitored products (Freedom Alert Max etc.) are subscriptions that auto-renew. Shipping & Returns page: returns within 30 days of delivery, no prepaid label, restocking fee withheld. Start a return via the form or 1-800-519-2419. No public bill-view, statement or autopay doc. Zendesk article: subscriptions for Amazon-bought devices are bought by phone with a credit card at 1-800-519-2419; the agent emails a detailed receipt and registers the device for monitoring. The Freedom Alert Caregiver app is free.

entries.name: Medical Alert (MedicalAlert.com)
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide direct-to-consumer PERS brand
entries.notes: Support page: 'Billing: Pay your Medical Alert bill online securely. Have your account number ready.' Includes a web form where you can choose 'Billing' as the issue type. Same Connect America back office as Lifeline. Support > General page  says cancel by emailing CustomerRelations@medicalalert.com or calling 800-800-1003; ship equipment to 816 Park Way, Broomall, PA 19008. Bill-pay portal: billpay.medicalalert.com (account number required). It lists customer service 800-906-0872 and general inquiries 800-800-2537, and bill pay at billpay.medicalalert.com (account number required). It has no autopay, statement-history or paperless doc. Subscriber terms: monthly monitoring plus tax and a one-time programming fee start the day equipment ships; the agreement auto-renews month to month until written notice to cancel, and charges continue until all equipment is received back; 3-month minimum is non-refundable, early cancellation also forfeits a $35 restocking fee; late fee $5/month; price increases need 30 days' written notice unless a price-lock was bought. No autopay enrollment, statement-history or paperless page is published; pay at billpay.medicalalert.com with the account number or call 800-906-0872. Cancel via CustomerRelations@medicalalert.com or 800-800-1003; ship equipment to 816 Park Way, Broomall PA. Subscriber terms: service renews month to month automatically, with a 3-month minimum monitoring charge paid at order; monthly charges continue until all equipment is returned and received; $35 restocking fee on early cancel; late fee as a monthly finance charge; price increases are invoiced with 30 days notice unless the price-lock guarantee was bought. MedicalAlert.com is Connect America's consumer brand; the Medical Alert Connect app also shows billing.

entries.name: Medical Care Alert
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS (home landline/cellular, GPS, smartwatch); Michigan-based
entries.payment_processor: in-house BigCommerce store account (card on file / ACH)
entries.senior_programs: FAQ says a medical alert system can be an eligible expense for some insurance, HSA or FSA plans.
entries.notes: The FAQ covers payment: credit, debit or ACH auto-withdrawal, billed quarterly, semi-annually or annually, with one month free on annual prepay. To cancel, notify them and return the equipment; prepaid balances are refunded after the first 14 days. It also lists 1-248-946-8172 for customer service and returns, and 844-692-5378 for Blue365 members. Shipping & Returns page  is the cancel/return doc: call 1-877-913-3680 for an RMA number; billing continues until the returned equipment is received, then prepaid balance is prorated and refunded to the payment on file within 30 business days; $350 damaged-equipment fee; $50 restocking fee for untested returns. It also says final or recurring charges go to the payment method on file and a $5 administrative fee applies if you need a paper invoice. FAQ: pay by credit/debit card or ACH checking withdrawal, billed quarterly, semi-annually or annually (one month free when paid annually). Monitoring Agreement: https://www.medicalcarealert.com/monitoring-agreement/ (month-to-month; billing stops when rented equipment is received). Web account at /account.php (login.php). No contract, cancel any time, no cancellation fees, price guaranteed.

entries.name: Medical Guardian
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide direct-to-consumer PERS (home and mobile); also Medicaid/MA payer programs
entries.mail_payment_address: Medical Guardian, PO Box 713269, Chicago, IL 60677-1269 (put account number in memo line)
entries.senior_programs: Some Medicare Advantage and Medicaid plans cover or reimburse; government/payer program page. Protection Plan for replacement buttons.
entries.notes: One FAQ page covers view billing (MyGuardian portal 'Billing' tab: make payments, change payment method, view/download invoices), autopay enrollment (bank account, Billing menu; Account Owners only), and mail address. No online autopay-cancel doc; cancel service by calling 1-800-313-1191 and selecting the cancellation option (90-day minimum; leased equipment must be returned to 106 Henderson Drive, Sharon Hill PA 19079 or a $350 charge applies). Stopping the service itself requires calling 1-800-313-1191. The billing content and mail address still match. Terms: sections 4.3-4.5 say membership fees bill automatically on the chosen cycle (monthly, quarterly or annual) to the card/bank on file; credit-card surcharge can be avoided by paying by debit or ACH; prepaid plans get a prorated refund past the 90-day minimum. Section 5.2 cancel by phone 1-800-313-1191 or in writing to Medical Guardian, Attn: Cancellations, 1818 Market Street, Suite 1200, Philadelphia, PA 19103; leased devices go back to 106 Henderson Drive, Sharon Hill, PA 19079 within 30 days or a $350 fee applies. Invoices can be viewed/downloaded in the MyGuardian portal Billing tab. No paperless-billing doc published. MyGuardian portal Billing tab (pay, change payment method, view/download invoices, bank autopay) and mail address PO Box 713269, Chicago IL 60677-1269 still match. Legal terms sec. 4.3/5: memberships bill monthly, quarterly or annually and auto-renew, charged to the payment method on file; 3-month minimum commitment. To cancel, call Member Support or write to Medical Guardian, Attn: Cancellations, 1818 Market Street Suite 1200, Philadelphia, PA 19103. Leased devices must be returned to 106 Henderson Drive, Sharon Hill, PA 19079; billing continues until the device is received, and $350 is charged to the card on file if it is not back within 30 days.

entries.name: MedicAlert Foundation
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide medical ID + 24/7 emergency response membership (annual renewal)
entries.notes: Annual membership plan with online 'Renew Plan' in My Account; billing docs are behind the login. Membership/protection page  lists annual plans: Safe $35/yr, Safe & Connected $55/yr, Safe & Found $75/yr. Memberships auto-renew annually with advance reminders. The renewal payment link https://my.medicalert.org/account?renewal=1 requires login. This is a membership (ID bracelet + record service), not a monitored alarm, so there is no equipment to return.

entries.name: MobileHelp
entries.parent_company: MobileHelp, LLC (acquired by ABRY Partners, 2017, per its press page)
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS (AT&T cellular)
entries.senior_programs: FAQ: some Medicare Advantage, Medicaid plans and private insurers may cover or reimburse.
entries.notes: Month-to-month, no contract, cancel any time (FAQ). Account management is in the MyMobileHelp member portal (mobilehelp.carehub365.com) and the MobileHelp app. No public doc on bill pay or autopay steps; call Member Support for billing. Terms and conditions: https://www.mobilehelp.com/pages/terms-and-conditions. The FAQ says billing can be monthly, quarterly or annual at the same rate plus sales tax, and card/debit/bank payments are accepted. Terms and conditions (Payment section) say billing starts at point of sale and renewals (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual) are auto-withdrawn from the default payment method on file, so autopay is the default and there is no separate enrollment. The return-policy page says cancel by calling 877-827-6207 (Customer Service option); leased equipment service ends the day the system is received back. To view your bill, use the app or web portal (mobilehelp.carehub365.com); account updates are also made there.

entries.name: One Call Alert (One Call Medical Alert)
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS
entries.payment_processor: Shopify store checkout; recurring charges auto-withdrawn from payment method on file
entries.notes: Onecallalert.com redirects to onecallmedicalalert.com. The FAQ  has no billing, autopay or cancellation details; call customer service. Terms and conditions  say billing starts at point of sale and renews each billing cycle (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual or annual), auto-withdrawn from the payment method on file; 1.5%/month on balances 30+ days past due; three-month minimum, prepaid monitoring beyond that is refunded; full refund (less up to $50 restocking) if equipment is returned within 10 days; $350 charge if the system is not returned within 30 days of cancellation. The same page is used for pay, autopay setup and cancel. FAQ has no billing content. Call customer service 1-800-913-9098 to cancel or for billing. Billing starts at point of sale, renews each cycle (monthly/quarterly/semi-annual/annual) by auto-withdrawal from the default payment method.

entries.name: QMedic
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide; mostly Medicaid MCO/AAA-funded PERS, plus private pay
entries.senior_programs: Mainly funded through Medicaid managed-care plans and Area Agencies on Aging via service authorizations; private pay available.
entries.notes: Consumer FAQ: no long-term contract; unused time is not refunded; subscription is not cancelled until the hardware is returned. Payer-funded members are billed to the MCO/AAA. $30/mo or $300/yr, option 2 for consumer billing, cancel by phone or email, and the subscription is not cancelled until the hardware is returned. Product terms of service: fees bill each payment period (monthly, quarterly or annual by plan) to the credit card on file or the linked checking account, and terms auto-renew for the same length unless written notice of non-renewal is given 30 days before term end; 30-day full refund if equipment is returned. FAQ: no long-term contract, but no refund for unused time, and the subscription is not cancelled until the hardware is back; QMedic emails or mails a return label and box. Most QMedic members are Medicaid-waiver/health-plan referrals with nothing to pay; program members with copay or private-pay questions email support with member ID. Consumer billing phone 877-241-2244 option 2. Unreturned or damaged PERS equipment is charged at replacement cost. QMedic FAQ is mainly for payers (MCOs, Area Agencies on Aging): billing and contracting start from a referral/service authorization; private-pay switch and copay questions go to the billing team; for terminated service QMedic sends a prepaid return label (and box) - email support for PERS equipment return. Suspension of service for lost eligibility is allowed for up to three months before the account is cancelled and hardware retrieved.

entries.name: Rescue Alert
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS
entries.payment_processor: Wix online store pricing plans (recurring card charge) or by phone
entries.notes: No billing docs online. Pricing plans page: equipment is rented monthly, quarterly (every 3 months) or annually (e.g., landline MXD $32.95/mo, $89.95/quarter, $335.40/yr; cellular MXD-LTE and myConnect mobile $42.95-$44.95/mo), or bought outright with $15.95-$20.95/mo monitoring; add-ons for fall detection ($10/mo) and wall button ($5/mo). 'Buy Now' plans are recurring subscriptions billed automatically to the card on file each cycle. No account portal, statements, cancellation or return page is published; call 1-800-688-9576 to change payment details, cancel and get return instructions for rented equipment. Monthly monitoring/rental and annual plans, recurring billing.

entries.name: ResponseNow
entries.service_area_detail: Nationwide PERS; Portland, OR
entries.notes: FAQ: no activation or equipment fees. Cancel by calling 866-795-4321 and returning the system to ResponseNow, 9900 SW Wilshire St., Ste. 250, Portland, OR 97225. It is the only billing-related doc. Cancel by calling 866-795-4321, then mail the equipment to ResponseNow, 9900 SW Wilshire St., Ste. 250, Portland, OR 97225; the account is cancelled when the equipment is received. Lost/damaged device: one-time replacement fee or a protection plan. No public pay-bill, autopay, statement or paperless page; billing questions go to 866-795-4321. Pricing policy: three payment plans - annual (pay once), quarterly (four equal payments) or monthly; no equipment fee; one-time activation fee; 30-day money-back guarantee with prepaid return label. Terms and conditions: service renews automatically for the same billing cycle until cancelled; payment is due in advance (initial payment at activation or online checkout) and is charged to the card or bank account on file; $35 late fee if a payment fails (e.g., expired card); to terminate, return the equipment with a written cancel request; unreturned equipment within 30 days is billed to the card/bank on file. No online account portal, statements or paperless option is published. 30-day money-back guarantee; cancel by phone and return the system with a prepaid label.
